newsitem.title: UGANDA: President Clinton will visit Africa in second term.
newsitem.headline: President Clinton will visit Africa in second term.

text.p: U.S. President Bill Clinton will make a tour of Africa sometime during the next four years, his wife, Hillary Rodham Clinton, said on Friday.

Mrs. Clinton, in a speech to members of Uganda's parliament, women's groups and others, said Clinton had asked her to make clear his commitment "that he will come to Africa during his second term as president".
"You will have much to show him, based on my own remarkable visit," Mrs. Clinton said as she neared the end of her own two- week tour of six African countries.

She did not say when Clinton might make the visit, but aides said it would not be this year as he has a busy schedule of foreign travel. Most speculation in Washington has been that such a trip would take place over the next two years.
